_comment: Maps each project on the site to the working directories it was built from.
Claude Code stores one .jsonl per session under ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/,
where the slug is the working directory with '/' replaced by '-'; the script
expands '~' and does that conversion, so paths are written here in normal form
and this file carries no absolute home path into a public repo.
A project built from more than one directory (a renamed repo, work done from a
parent dir) lists several. Add a project here and re-run tools/build_ledger.py.
'since' is optional (ISO date) and drops sessions before it — useful when a
directory was reused for something unrelated beforehand.
